title: Zeus ArcPods Case
description: The Zeus ArcPods Case is a handy accessory specifically designed for carrying ArcPods on the go. It’s a compact and convenient option for anyone looking to transport their pods easily, with a size that fits comfortably in the hand or pocket, measuring just 22 mm in diameter and 74 mm in height. Ideal for quick trips or evenings out, the Case ensures your ArcPods are always within reach, safeguarded, waterproof, easy-to-carry form
